title: Co-assembly of structurally different biomacromolecule-modified maghemite nanoparticles with nitrate sequestration potential
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN01037C, Paper
Hui Dong, Bo Su, YanXi Cheng, Saikat Ghosh, Nihar R. Pradhan, Bo Pan, Baoshan Xing
Sequestration of NO3− within the colloidal crystals produced from the co-assembly of humic acid and protein-modified maghemite NPs. This prevents the denitrification-mediated release of gaseous N-oxides with high global warming potential.
